<!-- Use a PR title accepted by CI: feat:, fix:, docs:, chore:, or refactor:. -->

## Summary

Describe the problem, the resulting behavior, and why this change is needed.

## Related issue

Link the issue or prior discussion. Use "Fixes #..." only when this PR resolves it.

## Changes

## Validation

List the commands and manual steps performed, their results, and the environment. Explain any checks not run and why. Include affected audio, UI, performance, and plugin-host behavior where relevant.

## Documentation and compatibility

Describe documentation updates, breaking changes, or migration steps. Include before/after screenshots for visible UI changes where useful.

## Checklist

- [ ] I read the repository's contributing.md and kept the change focused.
- [ ] I wrote this description and can explain and reproduce the validation.
- [ ] Relevant automated tests pass and affected targets build.
- [ ] I manually checked affected behavior, where applicable.
- [ ] I updated documentation for observable changes.
- [ ] I have the right to contribute the included code and assets.
- [ ] Any AI-assisted code was reviewed, tested, and understood by a qualified human.

At least one founder-team member must approve the PR before merging.
